recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is for core reconciliation. Follow-up Transport resource work should happen in the OO Incubator/source behind https://build.fhir.org/ig/HL7/oo-incubator/StructureDefinition-Transport.html unless a new final work-group decision explicitly returns Transport to core.
issue_request: FHIR-35939 was a Published/Persuasive R5 OO change request to create the initial Transport resource, with resolution text saying the resource would be added to the build as described by the Transport Resource Proposal.
initial_application: The issue was materially applied during R5 development. The initial Transport commit added fhir.ini resource registration plus source/transport StructureDefinition, examples, terminology, and search parameters, and PR #1686 merged the branch; the Jira application comment points to the final typo-fix commit in that PR.
additional_context: The proposal and OO minutes confirm the intended initial movement-resource scope and boundaries with Task. Later Transport decisions, especially FHIR-39512, refined Transport toward Event semantics. Current source history then removed Transport and several other OO resources from active core fhir.ini registration in commit 3b38b80, 'Remove OO resources and point to new incubator', and current core narrative links Transport to the OO Incubator IG. FHIR-53282 is relevant background for OO-Incubator Jira artifact configuration but is not final Applied/Published scope for this worker.
reconciliation: No core source was changed. Re-adding transport=Transport to current core fhir.ini would reverse the later incubator move, and editing the remaining source/transport files would affect legacy source outside current active core build scope.

related_jiras.note: R6 Applied decision narrowed Transport to Event semantics, explaining why current Transport content need not match the original Task-like proposal literally; this issue is already represented on the combined branch.
Tracks Jira artifact configuration for OO-Incubator additional resources, including Transport; not decided here because it is Resolved - change required and a separate configuration issue.
